name: PPT PRESENTATION
subtitle: PowerPoint & Idea Pitch Deck
description: Showcase your innovative ideas and technical presentation skills using structured slide decks.
rules: Presentation must be strictly prepared in PowerPoint or PDF format.
Maximum of 7 slides allowed per team.
5 minutes for presentation and 2 minutes for Q&A session.
Bring presentations on a virus-free USB drive.

rounds.name: Preliminary Deck Screening
rounds.desc: Initial slide deck review by panel judges.

rounds.name: Final Stage Pitch
rounds.desc: Live presentation followed by jury Q&A.

guidelines: Standard projector and clicker will be provided.
Presenters must report 15 minutes before the allocated slot.

name: CRACK THE CODE
subtitle: Code Craft & Bug Hunter
description: Test your logic and debugging prowess across intense algorithmic challenges and bug fixes.
rules: Individual participation only.
No built-in or external third-party libraries permitted.
Supported languages: C, C++, Java, and Python.
Plagiarism or tab switching results in instant disqualification.

rounds.name: Round 1: Written Logic Test
rounds.desc: MCQs covering syntax, complexity, and output prediction.

rounds.name: Round 2: Live Bug Hunting & Coding
rounds.desc: Fix broken code snippets and solve competitive problems.

guidelines: Desktop PCs will be provided with offline compilers.
Use of internet or mobile phones is strictly forbidden.

name: TECH QUIZ (ONLINE)
subtitle: Brain Bytes & Rapid Trivia
description: Rapid-fire online technology trivia covering computer fundamentals, latest trends, AI, and IT giants.
rules: Individual participation with browser lockdown enabled.
Negative marking for wrong answers in final buzzer round.
Screen recording and lock enforcement active.

rounds.name: Round 1: Rapid Fire MCQs
rounds.desc: 30 fast-paced technical questions.

rounds.name: Round 2: Identify the Tech & Buzz
rounds.desc: Audio-visual and logo identification.

rounds.name: Round 3: Grand Finale Showdown
rounds.desc: Buzzer-based tie-breaker and high-difficulty trivia.

guidelines: Ensure stable mobile data or connect to designated campus Wi-Fi.

name: WEB / PROMPT
subtitle: Web Design & Generative AI Prompting
description: Craft responsive web pages and generate AI visual assets through precision prompting.
rules: Individual or team of 2 members allowed.
Standard HTML5, CSS3, JS allowed on local machines.
Prompts must be logged and submitted with final code.

rounds.name: Round 1: Responsive Landing Page
rounds.desc: Design a pixel-perfect hero and feature section on given theme.

rounds.name: Round 2: AI Prompt Integration & Full UI
rounds.desc: Complete interactive web application with generated UI assets.

guidelines: VS Code and standard browsers will be pre-installed.

name: UI/UX
subtitle: Digital Prototype & Experience Design
rules: Individual competition.
Tools: Figma or Canva.
Direct AI-generated designs are strictly restricted.
Wireframes and color palettes must be presented.

rounds.name: Round 1: Auth & Onboarding Flow
rounds.desc: Design smooth login, registration, and onboarding screens.

rounds.name: Round 2: Feature Dashboard & Interactions
rounds.desc: Create main dashboard UI with interactive prototypes.

guidelines: Participants can bring their own laptops with Figma installed.

name: SNAP & REEL
subtitle: Frames & Cinematic Shots
description: Capture cinematic campus moments, dynamic event energy, and craft creative 30-60 second Instagram reels.
rules: Footage must be captured within campus grounds on event day.
Reel duration: 30 to 60 seconds.
Background audio/music permitted (no explicit content).

rounds.name: Campus Capture
rounds.desc: Shoot footage across symposium events.

rounds.name: Editing & Reel Submission
rounds.desc: Final color grading, sound mixing, and upload.

guidelines: Submission via Google Drive link or designated upload portal.

name: LINK UP (CONNECTION)
subtitle: Find The Hidden Link
description: Decode visual rebus puzzles, connected clues, movie scenes, and pop-culture links with fast buzzer reflexes.
rules: Max 3 members per squad.
Fastest buzzer gets priority to answer.
Negative score for incorrect buzzer attempts.

rounds.name: Round 1: Picture Rebus Clues
rounds.desc: Solve interconnected images to find movie or word titles.

rounds.name: Round 2: Rapid Buzzer Connection
rounds.desc: Complex multi-stage connection puzzles with countdown timer.

guidelines: Decisions of the quizmaster are final and binding.

name: HUNT ZONE (TREASURE HUNT)
subtitle: Quest of The Ancients
venue: Campus Wide / Starting at Main Lawn
description: An exciting treasure hunt across the campus uncovering riddles, cryptographic clues, and physical tokens.
rules: Teams of 2 to 4 members.
Do not tamper with non-clue campus assets or restricted areas.
First team to report with all verified tokens wins.

rounds.name: Clue Phase 1: Cryptic Riddles
rounds.desc: Solve campus location riddles to find checkpoint clues.

rounds.name: Clue Phase 2: Final Relic Recovery
rounds.desc: Assemble the master cipher and find the hidden treasure.

guidelines: Wear comfortable shoes for campus exploration.

name: HENNA HEIST (MEHANDI)
subtitle: Henna Art & Elegance
description: Display traditional Indian and Arabic henna patterns with intricacy, neatness, and artistic flair.
rules: Individual participant (can bring one volunteer model).
Time duration: 1 Hour.
Participants must bring their own henna cones.

rounds.name: Henna Application
rounds.desc: Apply elaborate pattern covering palm and forearm.

rounds.name: Jury Review
rounds.desc: Judged on symmetry, clarity, and creativity.

guidelines: No pre-drawn stencils or printed reference guides allowed during competition.

name: BATTLE OF CHAMPIONS (E-SPORTS)
subtitle: Mobile Battle Royale Showdown
description: Squad battle royale esports tournament. High strategy, fast gunplay, and survival tactics.
rules: 4-Player squad match only (Flat ₹200 entry fee per squad).
Emotes and unsportsmanlike behavior strictly restricted.
Third-party triggers and hacks will lead to immediate disqualification.

rounds.name: Match 1: Erangel / Bermuda Qualifiers
rounds.desc: Points awarded for kills and placement rank.

rounds.name: Match 2: Miramar Championship Finals
rounds.desc: Top squads battle for the title.

name: 64 SQUARES (CHESS)
subtitle: Grandmaster Board Tactics
description: Classical & Blitz chess championship testing tactical foresight, openings, and endgame mastery.
rules: Individual participation.
FIDE standard rapid time control (10 mins + 5 sec increment).
Touch-move rule strictly enforced.

rounds.name: Swiss System Rounds
rounds.desc: Players matched by score in standard Swiss pairing.

rounds.name: Knockout Semis & Finals
rounds.desc: Top 4 battle for championship trophy.

guidelines: Standard tournament chess sets and digital clocks provided.

name: AUCTION
subtitle: Bid. Think. Win.
description: Step into the world of strategy, wit, and quick decisions. Bid smart, outthink the rest, and take the win!

name: The Roborange Botathon
subtitle: Line-Follower Robot Competition
description: A line-following robot competition where autonomous bots navigate a designated track using onboard sensors — no manual control allowed once the run starts. Teams get a set number of attempts, and the fastest successful completion time determines the ranking. Points are deducted for leaving the track, skipping checkpoints, manual intervention, or touching the robot mid-run. Judges' decisions on time, penalties, performance, and qualification are final.

name: The Roborange Botathon
subtitle: Line-Follower Robot Competition
description: Watch autonomous robots race to follow a track using their own sensors — no remote control allowed. Fastest clean run wins, with penalty points for going off-track or any manual intervention.
rules: Each team must have 2–4 members and register one robot with a unique team name.
The robot must be a line-follower that runs fully autonomously — no manual or remote control during the run.
Ranking is based on the fastest successful completion time across the given attempts.
Penalty points apply for leaving the track, skipping checkpoints, or touching/moving the robot during a run.
The judges' decision on time, penalties, and qualification is final.
